name: smwmusic-among-us-when-the-imposter-is-snes-dead-body-reported-drip-theme-remix
title: Among Us - When the Imposter is SNES ~ Dead Body Reported Drip Theme (Remix)
description:
𝐖𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐢𝐦𝐩𝐨𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐢𝐬 𝐬𝐮𝐬.

Among Us has taken over my brain and forced me to make this lazy remix of of the Dead Body Reported Drip Theme theme. Jokes aside, I decided to do this for fun 'cuz I thought it'd be neat to come up with a short SNES arrangement of that song in my style.

It's very simple and short so definitely not best suited for long levels.

Important:
♠ There is 1 imposter among us.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. C Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. C# Minor (Custom Pitch 1)
2. A# Minor (Custom Pitch 2)
